lines.text: i looking at the walls as days went by
i don't know what's real or fake any
more i look at the mirror i
can't see myself like i used to in the past without you here
coming right at
me i can't stop i just went on without a destination
i can't see the walls surrounding me without a doubt it's never gone
what i have done i can't atone as days went on as i step on
the destination's still a far i'll never see you again
i remember the moment we first met
you looked so confused as we walked back home
i looked at myself in your eyes
tears never stop as i stare at the ceiling looking for a reason to live
as time goes on waiting for none
one has to ask where do i go from here
having lost everything
looking at my shadow
as i slowly fading away
like dust in the winter morning
as cold as my heart
i am losing my existence
disfigured beyond recognition
it is my admission
deconstruction
and let everything stop in motion
emotion
reconciliation
with my inner demon
i can't run from it
i can't even lie to myself
my despair is all that i have
i tried to grab something to help
me stay alive without a light
without a sight
without a signal
as i falling through my feeling
as i staring at myself
is there something to save (save)
(i) i can't stop i just went on without a destination
i can't see the walls surrounding me without a doubt it's never gone
what i have done i can't atone as days went on as i step on
the destination's still a far i'll never see you again
